summary: Added repo-wide system/business/app/ui ownership zones; this guidance is now consolidated in boundary-map.md.
Refactored ccb-wanding-web/src into app, system, business/chat, and ui directories without changing behavior.

Moved local user identity and runtime config out of app store into system modules; moved session HTTP behavior into business/chat/sessionApi.ts; moved websocket transport into system/realtime/chatSocketClient.ts.
Added ccb-wanding-web boundary guidance; this guidance is now consolidated in boundary-map.md so source directories stay focused on code.
Completed Phase 2 boundary pass for ccb-installer by adding AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and README markers for patches, src, scripts, lib, resources, config, dist, staging, vendor, and out.
Added Phase 5 for unrelated-file cleanup. Cleanup is audit-first: inventory, classify, update ignore rules where appropriate, then delete only safe/generated/temporary items after ownership is clear.

Audited Phase 1/2 cleanup candidates. Found no stale ccb-wanding-web src/components or src/hooks dirs. Recommended removing ccb-wanding-web build outputs and README markers placed inside generated/vendor roots.

Removed safe Phase 1/2 cleanup candidates: ccb-wanding-web/dist, ccb-wanding-web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, and README markers from ccb-installer dist/staging/vendor/out generated roots. Added ignore rules for node_modules, dist, and tsconfig.tsbuildinfo.
Completed Phase 3 boundary pass for MCP/Python by adding mcp_servers and python AGENTS/architecture docs plus package-level README files for quotation and inventory business ownership.
Consolidated boundary documentation into Trellis boundary-map.md and removed source-tree AGENTS/README/ARCHITECTURE docs created during phases 0-3, leaving only source code changes outside Trellis.

Completed Phase 4 AionUI/AionCore boundary pass in Trellis. Confirmed packages/desktop is absent in this checkout, mapped local AionCore crates as system/backend services, and kept Wanding quotation/inventory business ownership outside AionCore.

Extended cleanup audit with Python cache, temp output, workbook, and report candidates found while reviewing Phase 4. Did not delete them because ownership/test fixture status requires separate audit.

Completed Phase 5 high-confidence cleanup: removed Python pytest/bytecode caches, prior generated Python test/debug outputs, regenerated caches from verification, and transient tool-script pycache. Left ccb-installer and MCP dist payloads in place because they appear to be runtime/release artifacts rather than safe disposable clutter.

Completed Phase 6 Python system-adapter split. Added python/system/error_codes.py and python/system/workspace_paths.py, updated python/main.py to use system adapters, and kept python/wanding_workspace_paths.py as a compatibility import for existing quotation modules/tests.
Removed the legacy local error-code normalization block from python/main.py after moving that responsibility to python/system/error_codes.py.

Completed Phase 7 Python quotation business split. Moved direct-fill row normalization, fill candidate ranking, price-row lookup, and selected-row enrichment wiring from python/main.py into python/quotation/fill_items.py. main.py now calls the quotation business module via a compatibility alias.

Completed Phase 8 Python inventory service split. Moved inventory item normalization, no-data/no-credential payloads, and get_inventory_by_code_batch response assembly from python/main.py into python/inventory/services/inventory_payloads.py. main.py keeps compatibility aliases for existing tests/callers while dispatch stays focused on parameter extraction.

Updated tests/test_inventory_batch_payload.py to mock inventory.agents.table_agent via sys.modules so payload tests do not require the optional requests/Accurate client dependency in this environment.

Completed Phase 9 Python quotation selection split. Moved match selection payload shape, candidate caps, knowledge-source pointer, and match_quotation_batch continuation payload assembly from python/main.py into python/quotation/selection_payloads.py. main.py keeps _build_selection_payload as a compatibility alias and delegates batch payload assembly to the quotation module.

Completed Phase 10 Python system adapter split. Moved tool dispatch, adapter parameter coercion, default template resolution, and handle_request error wrapping from python/main.py into python/system/tool_dispatch.py. python/main.py is now the JSON-lines stdin/stdout entrypoint and keeps compatibility re-exports for dispatch, handle_request, _normalize_fill_items, _build_selection_payload, and _build_inventory_by_code_batch_payload.

Completed Phase 11 entrypoint cleanup. Updated Python tests and smoke_wanding_e2e.py to import dispatch/handle_request and business helpers from their real system/quotation/inventory modules, then removed test-only compatibility re-exports from python/main.py.

Completed Phase 12 workspace path compatibility cleanup. Moved the remaining quotation/test imports to python/system/workspace_paths.py and deleted the obsolete root python/wanding_workspace_paths.py wrapper.

Completed Phase 13 inventory search payload split. Added build_search_inventory_payload under python/inventory/services/inventory_payloads.py, updated search_inventory dispatch to delegate response shaping, and covered empty/found search payload behavior in tests.

Completed Phase 14 price-inventory selection payload split. Added build_price_inventory_selection_payload under python/quotation/selection_payloads.py, updated match_price_and_get_inventory dispatch to delegate multi-candidate payload shaping, and covered the Indonesian-name fallback directly in tests.

Completed Phase 15 clarification payload split. Added build_clarification_payload under python/quotation/selection_payloads.py, updated ask_clarification dispatch to delegate payload shaping, covered default options and dispatch routing in tests, and repaired the corrupted price-inventory source default to ASCII common.

Completed Phase 16 org-knowledge confirmation payload split. Added python/admin/org_knowledge_payloads.py, updated append_business_rule dispatch to delegate unconfirmed write confirmation payload shaping, and covered the payload builder plus dispatch route in tests.

Completed Phase 17 quotation template path split. Added python/quotation/template_paths.py, moved default blank quotation template discovery out of python/system/tool_dispatch.py, removed dispatch-level template env/root discovery state, and covered WANDING_DATA_DIR lookup in tests.

Completed Phase 18 quotation fill output path split. Extended python/quotation/template_paths.py with direct-fill and flow-fill output path helpers, moved Wanding-Quotation timestamp and _filled filename defaults out of python/system/tool_dispatch.py, and covered workspace-required/default-stem behavior in tests.

Completed Phase 19 quotation fill tool dispatch split. Added python/quotation/fill_dispatch.py, moved fill_quotation_sheet parameter aliases, confirmed-fill guard, direct-fill branch, and flow-fill branch out of python/system/tool_dispatch.py, and covered the business guard directly in tests.

Completed Phase 20 quotation match tool dispatch split. Added python/quotation/match_dispatch.py, moved match_quotation, match_quotation_batch, and match_price_and_get_inventory parameter aliases, business calls, and selection branching out of python/system/tool_dispatch.py, and covered the price+inventory business dispatch directly in tests.

Completed Phase 21 inventory tool dispatch split. Added python/inventory/services/inventory_dispatch.py, moved get_inventory_by_code, get_inventory_by_code_batch, and search_inventory parameter aliases, InventoryTableAgent calls, list coercion, and inventory payload branching out of python/system/tool_dispatch.py, and covered nested-code inventory batch dispatch directly in tests.

Completed Phase 22 org-knowledge tool dispatch split. Added python/admin/org_knowledge_dispatch.py, moved append_business_rule parameter aliases, confirmation bool coercion, confirmation payload delegation, and org knowledge write dispatch out of python/system/tool_dispatch.py, and covered alias handling directly in tests.

Completed Phase 23 quotation parse tool dispatch split. Added python/quotation/parse_dispatch.py, moved parse_excel_smart file path aliases, sheet/max-row parameter forwarding, and quotation parse call dispatch out of python/system/tool_dispatch.py, and covered the excel_path alias directly in tests.

Completed Phase 24 quotation clarification tool dispatch split. Added handle_ask_clarification in python/quotation/selection_payloads.py, moved ask_clarification routing behind a quotation-layer handler, and covered the business handler directly in tests.

Completed Phase 25 quotation tool adapter split. Added python/quotation/tool_adapter.py, moved the OpenAI-style execute_quote_tool implementation out of python/quotation/quote_tools.py, updated package exports to use the adapter, and left quote_tools.py with only a compatibility shim for direct imports.

Completed Phase 26 quotation tool schema split. Added python/quotation/tool_schema.py, moved get_quote_tools_openai_format and OpenAI-style tool metadata out of python/quotation/quote_tools.py, updated package exports to use the schema module, and left quote_tools.py with a compatibility shim.

Completed Phase 27 quotation layout model split. Added python/quotation/layout.py, moved QuotationTemplateLayout plus LINGWEI_LAYOUT and VANTSING_LAYOUT out of python/quotation/quote_tools.py, and updated internal fill row guard/backfill modules plus tests to import layout definitions directly.

Completed Phase 28 generic Excel edit split. Added python/quotation/excel_edit.py, moved edit_excel and A1 cell-reference parsing out of python/quotation/quote_tools.py, updated the quotation tool adapter to import edit_excel from the new module, and left quote_tools.py with compatibility shims.

Completed Phase 29 shared Excel IO split. Added python/quotation/excel_io.py, moved writable-path and workbook-save helpers out of python/quotation/quote_tools.py, updated excel_edit.py to depend on excel_io instead of quote_tools.py, and left quote_tools.py with compatibility shims.
